answer.diagnosis: The kernel assumes unit sequence strides and uses the ID batch stride to address the mask. Independent prefixes, strided views, and broadcast views therefore read incorrect IDs or mask values. Actual GPU observations report 7, 12, 13, 9, and 10 mismatches out of 21 for grpo-01 through grpo-05; the dense control grpo-00 has zero mismatches. Pass both dimensions' strides independently for IDs and masks, preserving suffix slicing, FP32 computation, zero masked outputs, and inputs. Zero strides naturally support broadcast views; mask=None uses unused zero mask strides. Compilation and post-patch correctness cannot be verified through this catalog; supplied observations cover only masked FP32 inputs at temperature 1.
